verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a GPU cloud, since some providers offer on-prem or customer-run deployments. The evidence, however, only describes Lambda-hosted services: On-Demand Cloud, 1-Click Clusters, managed Kubernetes and Slurm, and a single-tenant Private Cloud that Lambda still operates. Nothing shows customers can run Lambda's core platform or software on their own infrastructure; root access on Lambda-hosted nodes and a preinstalled Lambda Stack are adjacent features, not self-hosting.
